title: security-audit coverage ledger
description: Which entry points and bug classes were checked, by whom, with what evidence. Written per auditor to .security-audit/coverage/<auditor>.json; merged into .security-audit/coverage.json by scripts/coverage.mjs --write. Validated by scripts/coverage.mjs (no dependencies; it implements the keywords used here).

generated_at.description: set by coverage.mjs --write on the merged file

class.description: bug class: a canonical finding category (checklist 2.1-2.12, test-gap for Phase 4), or all for a gap that spans every class

target.description: the file of the entry point or code checked, relative to the project root, or * for a project-wide check (dependencies, headers, config)

handler.description: route or handler inside target, e.g. POST /api/uploads or invoiceRouter.update

check.description: the checklist item or question, in a few words

auditor.description: who recorded the row: coordinator, recon, verifier, test-quality or auditor-<name>

items.description: a finding or non-issue id (auth-101, non-auth-101) or a path:line

reason.description: why the class does not apply or could not be assessed

carried_from.description: written by prepass --since only: the commit of the run this row was carried from
